title: Rework worker.pre_dispatch hook integration without weakening event budgets
instructions:
Rework the previous passing candidate run /Users/byung/Documents/samantha/runs/2026-05-24T04-25-12-540Z-hook-system-s5-7-worker-pre-dispatch-integration.json, commit 58aef3487dead7ff93d601cc8493bcd20818cf09. Do not accept that commit as-is. Implement the same worker.pre_dispatch runtime integration, but fix the review blockers below.

Review blocker 1: the previous candidate weakened S5.6 trust-gate event budget semantics in src/core/hooks.ts. It changed commandTimeoutWithinEventBudget so hook commands may receive more than the remaining event budget. This is not acceptable. Preserve the existing S5.6 rule: before each expensive trust-gate operation, command execution must be bounded by the remaining event budget. Restore commandTimeoutWithinEventBudget to use remainingTrustGateEventBudget(eventBudget), and do not pass a larger per-hook timeout to runHook as a workaround. If integration tests need more budget, adjust test hook policy/default event timeout or test timing, not the trust-gate runner invariant.

Add a focused regression test in tests/hooks.test.ts if practical: when an earlier trust-gate hook consumes most of eventTimeoutMs, a later hook command must not be able to run past the remaining event budget and perform a delayed side effect. Keep the test deterministic enough for CI; avoid over-tight timing assertions if marker-file evidence is more stable.

Review blocker 2: keep hook evidence additive and outside worker-result authority. It is acceptable for executeWorkerDispatch/runTaskCommand to carry hook evidence internally, but worker run logs should not duplicate hook evidence inside result if that makes hook output look like part of WorkerDispatchExecution authority. Prefer top-level log.hookEvidence as the persistent evidence surface. If you keep a transient execution.hookEvidence field for plumbing, ensure buildWorkerRunLog strips it from result or otherwise prove run logs do not duplicate it under result.hookEvidence. Add or update tests to assert top-level hookEvidence exists for hook runs and parsed.result.hookEvidence is absent.

Continue to satisfy the original integration requirements:
- Execute worker.pre_dispatch trust-gate hooks after prepareWorkerDispatch succeeds and after worktree allocation/codex preparation, but before setupCommands and before runtimeAdapter.execute.
- Load hook policy from preparation.worktreePath, the actual worker cwd.
- If policy is missing, preserve existing behavior and omit empty hookEvidence log noise.
- If policy is disabled, enabled, invalid, or otherwise present, record diagnosable hook evidence where practical.
- Trust-gate block must stop setupCommands, worker command, evaluation, and commit; WorkerDispatchExecution.pass must be false; dispatchError must clearly name worker.pre_dispatch hook gate and include the final summary.
- runTaskCommand must connect hook evidence to writeWorkerRunLog.
- Hook evidence must include policy path/digest, definition path/digest for loaded definitions, worker.pre_dispatch event/version, trustGate final decision, and invocation evidence.
- Context must be bounded to top-level keys task, agent, dispatch. Do not include task instructions, raw transcripts, credentials, connector data, hidden memory, or arbitrary file contents.
- Do not run worker.pre_dispatch hooks for dispatch validation failures before prepareWorkerDispatch succeeds.
- Do not add task_spec.preflight integration, advisory runtime hooks, CLI flags, MCP, plugin behavior, daemon/watch behavior, remote behavior, lifecycle authority, worker-result authority changes, real references/hooks artifacts, documentation edits, retries, parallel hook execution, dynamic dispatch, or new policy schema fields.

Required tests from the original slice still apply:
- no hook policy keeps existing worker dispatch/run-task behavior and omits hookEvidence;
- passed + allow hook lets setup, worker command, evaluation, and commit continue and records allow evidence;
- blocked + block hook prevents setup, worker command, evaluation, and commit and records block evidence;
- invalid present policy fails closed before worker execution with diagnosable dispatchError/evidence;
- dispatch validation block remains a pre-hook failure with no hookEvidence;
- existing hooks, run-log, and worker-dispatch tests pass.
expectedCommitSubject: feat: integrate worker pre-dispatch hook gate
